lesson.title: When solutions fail or are not unique
lesson.purpose: Classify unique, inconsistent and dependent small systems and represent a simple solution family.
lesson.scope: Contradiction versus redundant equation after elimination; parallel/coincident lines; a free parameter in a dependent two-unknown system; interpret a parameterised family by substitution.
lesson.boundary: No rank theorem or abstract null spaces. A singular coefficient matrix alone cannot distinguish no solutions from infinitely many.
lesson.practiceAndEvidence: Classify deliberately similar systems with different right-hand sides; show one inconsistent and one dependent case; check two members of a solution family and explain why examples alone do not describe the whole family.
lesson.visualPlan: Intersecting, parallel and coincident line pairs aligned with their reduced equations.
lesson.handover: L05 connects 2D invertibility and determinant with this distinction.
